ZBoard is a self-hosted panel for Zero proxy services. This release candidate includes the console redesign and the plugin storage and authentication diagnostics changes made since `v0.0.2-rc.202609240544`.

## Changes

- Replace the PrimeVue presentation layer with shared shadcn-vue/Reka UI components and consistent design tokens. Tables, filters, pagination, dialogs, row actions and date ranges use common interaction patterns.
- Rework administrator navigation with page-level sections, menu search, an upper-right account menu, version information and release checks. Clicking a menu group expands it without navigating to its first page.
- Refine dashboard hierarchy, public storefront actions, account views and responsive layouts. Signed-in visitors selecting a public plan continue in the account purchase flow.
- Add navigation progress and page rendering transitions. Optional plugin slots stay collapsed until content is ready, and optional login extensions do not block the password login form.
- Refine provider, DNS and certificate administration forms and feedback.
- Prune unused plugin package versions and temporary import/repair directories during plugin lifecycle operations and startup. Installed versions remain available; historical uploads are no longer retained as a rollback archive. Reinstall an exact publisher version or import its package when needed. Plugin configuration and private data retain their existing lifecycle policy.
- Show actionable external-login failure categories and record server-side callback diagnostics without exposing authorization codes or tokens. This improves diagnosis; it does not establish that a particular production OAuth provider issue is resolved.

## Updating

Use this exact RC image tag rather than the stable `latest` tag. Back up the database, deployment configuration, encryption keys, plugin packages and managed rules before upgrading. Preserve the previous application image and any plugin package required for rollback.

When upgrading from an older release, follow the ordered migration procedure: run one instance with `-migrate-only`, then start application instances after migration completes. Preserve the existing credential encryption key. This RC does not bundle updates to separately installed plugins; update those through their publisher when required.

This is a release candidate for deployment and interaction validation. Publication does not deploy the release to an existing site.
